summary: No blocking integrity defect found. Both new full50 best matrices and all8 new frozen states independently match their full-query outputs; all100 epoch CSVs, order/loss/coverage, native/parity, local checkpoint rebuild, terminal records and six archives agree. F-local axis E15 is weaker than preserved global AV42; no +1/+1 gain or goal completion is supported. Saved band geometry and separately sealed rescue-overlap diagnostics reproduce as qualified diagnostics. Semantic review remains same-family/provisional.

nonblocking_findings.detail: Full official benchmark mAP selects the earliest maximum checkpoint among 50 epochs; recipe development also uses this benchmark. One teacher42/fresh expert42 ordinary-axis pair is conditional on the already trained DeMo50 teacher. Main BestSingle reporting with all six values from one checkpoint is respected; mean/interval or multi-seed gates are not imposed. This is not a fresh untouched test, an N5 seed, or an independently repeated whole pipeline.

F-local axis E15 is 86.00601296933065 mAP and 96.5597667638484 Rank-1, below preserved AV42 axis E20 by 0.14863033228743916 and 0.2332361516034922 percentage points. It is also 0.0583090379008695 Rank-1 points below original DeMo. Local axis exceeds local ordinary by only 0.033028494192492985 mAP and 0.05830903790088371 Rank-1 points. No +1/+1 target is met. All negative cases must remain, with AV42 retained as the existing stronger axis result.

Eight states are evaluations of two fixed best checkpoints, not independently retrained module ablations or missing-modality experiments. The overlap addendum is offline GT diagnosis: 7 local rescues, 8 local harms, no local-only rescue versus AV. The 97.0262390670554 fixed-state oracle cannot be deployed and does not bound a future representation.

Both models have 99,585,158 parameters, 1,887,366 trainable parameters and a 5120-D descriptor, but equal parameter counts do not establish equal cost. The reported selected-Q/G times include decoding and the first batch. Peak memory is torch max allocated for the whole process without reset, including construction/training/evaluation; it is not reserved or device-wide memory. Historical and current timings are actual run observations, not an isolated latency/scaling comparison.

All ten child exit receipts are zero and the terminal intake records original controller and children absent. Detached controller OS exit remains UNATTESTED. No current remote process, GPU, log or deletion-state query was performed. Reviewer actual model and effort remain UNATTESTED; same-family semantic review is provisional.

Fresh raw reranking covers all 10 indexed new matrices. All 100 new epoch CSVs are reaggregated and bound to epoch JSON/epochs/logs; raw epoch distance matrices were not retained. State archives retain 00 features and all four distances, but no separate 11 features; 11 feature equality rests on the indexed executed producer assertion while 11 distance equality is independently checked. The two new best weights were byte-compared, including 601 frozen identity tensors. Original teacher weight, remote image bytes, and old AV42 binaries were not reopened; their prior audit/provenance is explicitly reused.

All 10290 saved AV42 rows, 275 spatial measures plus seven metadata fields and all 18 aggregate source-band records check. Original masks contain 7/18/103 positions; one .25/.375 candidate contains 25/30/73. The latter is an unimplemented CPU geometry candidate. Counts and old statistics do not establish energy balance, unequal usefulness, a causal defect, or a retrieval gain.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Metadata comes from official RGBNT100 installed filenames, not model outputs. Current local recount reparses identity and camera from all 18965 split names, checks canonical ordering, 50/50 disjoint train/test identities, all 1715 valid queries, and all four archive metadata blocks against the split manifest. Installed-file provenance is evidenced by indexed audit sources and completed child receipts; no fresh server filesystem or image-content verification is claimed.

B_score_normalization.details: Stable ascending distance with original gallery order for ties; exclude only same identity AND same camera. AP averages relevant precisions, INP divides relevant count by last relevant rank, and CMC uses first match. All are percentages of real queries; no denominator from predicted score maxima/means. Standard feature L2 normalization is distinct from metric scaling. All 147061250 raw distance values are finite and all 17150 ranked query cases match CSVs.

C_result_existence_execution_selection_a.details: 697 indexed files remain exact before/after; 2 separately sealed addendum files also exact. Both full50 results, all100 epoch CSVs/JSON summaries, paired13126 formal updates, six native updates, grid1 parity64 record executions, all10 child exit0 receipts and six D archives agree. One checkpoint per row selected by earliest maximum mAP. Both 11 distance matrices are exactly the saved selected normal distance matrices; both 00 rows equal the original baseline. Existing seven remote duplicate deletions are supported by source, archive hashes and the indexed receipt, not newly performed.

D_called_evaluation_and_local_grid_rebui.details: The called runner evaluates every epoch and strictly reloads the mAP-best. The state producer rebuilds build_local(parent=AV, grid=2) from saved training arguments before strict loading, independently enumerates installed metadata, actually computes four full states, asserts 11 feature/distance identity, 00 original-row identity, tensor-version stability and frozen teacher identity. The installed grid index is nonpersistent; it is correctly absent from both serialized checkpoints. No claimed result depends solely on an uncalled metric function. The legacy standalone full_evaluation main/docstring uses an old dev protocol, but the current runner invokes its full_metrics/extract/distance helpers and explicitly uses official benchmark selection.

E_scope_and_claims.details: The completed pair supports a negative F-local normal-retrieval result, with a matched ordinary grid control and reused same-seed global AV42. It supports no new winning model, no missing/new49 result, no retrained-ablation claim, no causal energy-balancing explanation and no whole-goal completion. BestSingle is the user-authorized main rule; uncertainty intervals are not a completion gate.

F_evaluation_type.details: Official retrieval metrics use dataset identities and camera exclusion. The separate rescue oracle is explicitly offline label-based diagnosis and is not a new deployable model score.

results.main_reporting_rule: BestSingle; all six metrics in each row from the same chosen checkpoint; no compulsory multi-seed mean/interval gate

No independent current 11-feature array exists in state NPZ; exact 11-feature equality is a source-bound executed producer assertion, with current byte-exact 11 distance equality.

Frozen states, band geometry, and GT rescue/oracle diagnostics are interventions/diagnostics, not retrained ablations, energy evidence, causal explanation, new missing results, or bounds on future learned models.
